Options: 
A. 11110000, 00001111
B. 01111111, 10000000
C. 00000001, 10000000
D. 10000001, 10101010
E. 11111111, 00000001
F. 11111111, 10000001
G. 00000000, 10000000
H. 10000001, 00000001
I. 10101010, 11111111

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
